text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The summer training camp finally starts tomorrow, desu wa!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Kawakami. That's why we're sleeping!!
Let's save all that excitement for tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...This is for your own good, too.
Good night, good girl..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (I knew it, I can't sleep at all~!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I am quite fine...
...My eyes are wide awake...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first day of summer training camp. I immediately adjusted the schedule,
having her rest before starting her training...
